d: Is Saudi Arabia actually losing the war to the Houthis in Yemen? Saudi Arabia consistently ranks among the top five military spenders on the planet. Armed with state-of-the-art American F-15 fighter jets, Apache attack helicopters, and multi-million-dollar Patriot missile defense batteries, the kingdom launched Operation Decisive Storm in 2015 expecting to crush the Houthi rebellion in a matter of weeks. Fast forward over a decade later, and the outcome has defied every conventional military projection.
